raw_segments.text: And liver gravy bloom mashed mashed potatoes. Love and war someone is. Ben Dollard's famous.
Night he ran round to us to borrow a dress suit for that concert.
Trousers tight as a drum on him. Musical porkers.
Molly did laugh when he went out.
Threw herself back across the bed screaming, kicking, with all his belongings on show.
Oh, saints above, I'm drenched. Oh, the women in the front row.
Oh, I never laughed so many.
Well, of course, that's what gives him the bass barrel tone. For instance, eunuchs.
Wonder who's playing. Nice touch. Must be Cowley.
Musical. Knows whatever note you play. Bad breath he has. Poor chap. Stopped.
